translations.idiomatic: Moreover, when former kings passed away, they still left behind virtue and established laws. How much more so when taking away good people and worthy ministers whom the common people grieve for?

sentences.zh: 是以知秦不能復東征也。」

translations.literal: Therefore, know Qin cannot again east campaign.'
translations.idiomatic: Therefore, we know Qin cannot campaign east again.'

sentences.zh: 繆公子四十人，其太子嵤代立，是為康公。

translations.literal: Mu Gong sons forty people, his crown prince Chong succeeded ascended throne, this Kang Gong.
translations.idiomatic: Duke Mu had forty sons. His crown prince Chong succeeded to the throne and was called Kang Gong.

sentences.zh: 康公元年。

translations.literal: Kang Gong first year.
translations.idiomatic: Kang Gong's first year.

sentences.zh: 往歲繆公之卒，晉襄公亦卒；

translations.literal: Previous year Mu Gong died, Jin Xiang Gong also died;
translations.idiomatic: In the previous year, Duke Mu died, and Duke Xiang of Jin also died;

sentences.zh: 襄公之弟名雍，秦出也，在秦。

translations.literal: Xiang Gong younger brother named Yong, Qin birth, in Qin.
translations.idiomatic: Duke Xiang's younger brother named Yong was born of a Qin mother and was in Qin.

sentences.zh: 晉趙盾欲立之，使隨會來迎雍，秦以兵送至令狐。

translations.literal: Jin Zhao Dun wished establish him, made Sui Hui come welcome Yong, Qin with troops escorted to Linghu.
translations.idiomatic: Zhao Dun of Jin wished to establish him. He sent Sui Hui to welcome Yong, and Qin escorted him with troops to Linghu.

sentences.zh: 晉立襄公子而反擊秦師，秦師敗，隨會來奔。

translations.literal: Jin established Xiang Gong son and instead attacked Qin troops, Qin troops defeated, Sui Hui came fled.
translations.idiomatic: Jin established Duke Xiang's son instead and attacked the Qin troops. The Qin troops were defeated, and Sui Hui fled here.

sentences.zh: 二年，秦伐晉，取武城，報令狐之役。

translations.literal: Second year, Qin attacked Jin, took Wu Cheng, repaid Linghu campaign.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year, Qin attacked Jin, took Wu Cheng, to repay the Linghu campaign.

sentences.zh: 四年，晉伐秦，取少梁。

translations.literal: Fourth year, Jin attacked Qin, took Shao Liang.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year, Jin attacked Qin and took Shao Liang.

sentences.zh: 六年，秦伐晉，取羈馬。

translations.literal: Sixth year, Qin attacked Jin, took Ji Ma.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year, Qin attacked Jin and took Ji Ma.

sentences.zh: 戰於河曲，大敗晉軍。

translations.literal: Battled at He Qu, greatly defeated Jin army.
translations.idiomatic: They battled at He Qu and greatly defeated the Jin army.

sentences.zh: 晉人患隨會在秦為亂，乃使魏讎餘詳反，合謀會，詐而得會，會遂歸晉。

translations.literal: Jin people worried Sui Hui in Qin made chaos, then made Wei Chou Yu pretended rebel, united plotted Hui, deceived and obtained Hui, Hui then returned Jin.
translations.idiomatic: The Jin people worried that Sui Hui would stir up trouble in Qin. They therefore had Wei Chou Yu pretend to rebel, join Hui in a plot, and deceive him, bringing Hui back to Jin.

sentences.zh: 康公立十二年卒，子共公立。

translations.literal: Kang Gong established twelve years died, son Gong Gong established.
translations.idiomatic: Kang Gong ruled for twelve years and died. His son Duke Gong was established.

sentences.zh: 共公二年，晉趙穿弒其君靈公。

translations.literal: Gong Gong second year, Jin Zhao Chuan assassinated his lord Ling Gong.
translations.idiomatic: In Duke Gong's second year, Zhao Chuan of Jin assassinated his lord Duke Ling.

sentences.zh: 三年，楚莊王彊，北兵至雒，問周鼎。

translations.literal: Third year, Chu Zhuang Wang strong, north troops reached Luo, asked Zhou tripod.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year, King Zhuang of Chu was strong. He marched north with troops to Luo and inquired about the Zhou tripod.

sentences.zh: 共公立五年卒，子桓公立。

translations.literal: Gong Gong established five years died, son Huan Gong established.
translations.idiomatic: Duke Gong ruled for five years and died. His son Huan Gong was established.

sentences.zh: 桓公三年，晉敗我一將。

translations.literal: Huan Gong third year, Jin defeated our one general.
translations.idiomatic: In Huan Gong's third year, Jin defeated one of our generals.

sentences.zh: 十年，楚莊王服鄭，北敗晉兵於河上。

translations.literal: Tenth year, Chu Zhuang Wang submitted Zheng, north defeated Jin troops on Yellow River.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year, King Zhuang of Chu brought Zheng into submission and defeated Jin troops north of the Yellow River.

sentences.zh: 當是之時，楚霸，為會盟合諸侯。

translations.literal: At this time, Chu hegemoned, made alliances gathered feudal lords.
translations.idiomatic: At this time, Chu was hegemon and held alliances gathering the feudal lords.

sentences.zh: 二十四年，晉厲公初立，與秦桓公夾河而盟。

translations.literal: Twenty-fourth year, Jin Li Gong newly established, with Qin Huan Gong flanked river allied.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-fourth year, Duke Li of Jin was newly established. He made an alliance with Duke Huan of Qin flanking the river.

sentences.zh: 歸而秦倍盟，與翟合謀擊晉。

translations.literal: Returned and Qin doubled alliance, with Di united plotted attacked Jin.
translations.idiomatic: They returned and Qin violated the alliance, uniting with the Di to plot against Jin.

sentences.zh: 二十六年，晉率諸侯伐秦，秦軍敗走，追至涇而還。

translations.literal: Twenty-sixth year, Jin led feudal lords attacked Qin, Qin army defeated fled, pursued to Jing then returned.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-sixth year, Jin led the feudal lords to attack Qin. The Qin army was defeated and fled. They pursued to the Jing and then returned.

sentences.zh: 桓公立二十七年卒，子景公立。

translations.literal: Huan Gong established twenty-seven years died, son Jing Gong established.
translations.idiomatic: Huan Gong ruled for twenty-seven years and died. His son Jing Gong was established.

sentences.zh: 景公四年，晉欒書弒其君厲公。

translations.literal: Jing Gong fourth year, Jin Luan Shu assassinated his lord Li Gong.
translations.idiomatic: In Jing Gong's fourth year, Luan Shu of Jin assassinated his lord Duke Li.

sentences.zh: 十五年，救鄭，敗晉兵於櫟。

translations.literal: Fifteenth year, rescued Zheng, defeated Jin troops at Li.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifteenth year, they rescued Zheng and defeated Jin troops at Li.

sentences.zh: 是時晉悼公為盟主。

translations.literal: This time Jin Dao Gong was alliance leader.
translations.idiomatic: At this time, Duke Dao of Jin was the alliance leader.

sentences.zh: 十八年，晉悼公彊，數會諸侯，率以伐秦，敗秦軍。

translations.literal: Eighteenth year, Jin Dao Gong strong, repeatedly assembled feudal lords, led to attack Qin, defeated Qin army.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighteenth year, Duke Dao of Jin was strong. He repeatedly assembled the feudal lords and led them to attack Qin, defeating the Qin army.

sentences.zh: 秦軍走，晉兵追之，遂渡涇，至棫林而還。

translations.literal: Qin army fled, Jin troops pursued them, then crossed Jing, reached Yu Lin then returned.
translations.idiomatic: The Qin army fled. The Jin troops pursued them, then crossed the Jing, reached Yu Lin, and returned.

sentences.zh: 二十七年，景公如晉，與平公盟，已而背之。

translations.literal: Twenty-seventh year, Jing Gong went to Jin, with Ping Gong allied, then betrayed it.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-seventh year, Duke Jing went to Jin and made an alliance with Duke Ping, then betrayed it.

sentences.zh: 三十六年，楚公子圍弒其君而自立，是為靈王。

translations.literal: Thirty-sixth year, Chu nobleman Wei assassinated his lord self established, this Ling Wang.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-sixth year, Chu's nobleman Wei assassinated his lord and established himself, becoming King Ling.

sentences.zh: 景公母弟後子鍼有寵，景公母弟富，或譖之，恐誅，乃奔晉，車重千乘。

translations.literal: Jing Gong mother younger brother Hou Zi Zhen had favor, Jing Gong mother younger brother Fu, someone slandered him, feared execution, then fled Jin, chariots heavy thousand chariots.
translations.idiomatic: Duke Jing's younger maternal brother Hou Zi Zhen was favored. Duke Jing's younger maternal brother Fu was wealthy. Someone slandered him. Fearing execution, he fled to Jin with a thousand chariots of possessions.

sentences.zh: 晉平公曰：「后子富如此，何以自亡？」

translations.literal: Jin Ping Gong said: 'Hou Zi rich like this, why self perished?'
translations.idiomatic: Duke Ping of Jin said: 'Hou Zi is rich like this. Why did he cause his own ruin?'

sentences.zh: 對曰：「秦公無道，畏誅，欲待其後世乃歸。」

translations.literal: Replied said: 'Qin gong without way, feared execution, wished wait his later generations then return.'
translations.idiomatic: He replied: 'The lord of Qin is without the Way. I feared execution. I wish to wait for his later generations and then return.'

sentences.zh: 三十九年，楚靈王彊，會諸侯於申，為盟主，殺齊慶封。

translations.literal: Thirty-ninth year, Chu Ling Wang strong, assembled feudal lords at Shen, became alliance leader, killed Qi Qing Feng.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-ninth year, King Ling of Chu was strong. He assembled the feudal lords at Shen, became the alliance leader, and killed Qing Feng of Qi.

sentences.zh: 景公立四十年卒，子哀公立。

translations.literal: Jing Gong established forty years died, son Ai Gong established.
translations.idiomatic: Jing Gong ruled for forty years and died. His son Ai Gong was established.

sentences.zh: 后子復來歸秦。

translations.literal: Hou Zi again came returned Qin.
translations.idiomatic: Hou Zi came back and returned to Qin.

sentences.zh: 哀公八年，楚公子棄疾弒靈王而自立，是為平王。

translations.literal: Ai Gong eighth year, Chu nobleman Qi Ji assassinated Ling Wang self established, this Ping Wang.
translations.idiomatic: In Ai Gong's eighth year, Chu's nobleman Qi Ji assassinated King Ling and established himself, becoming King Ping.

sentences.zh: 十一年，楚平王來求秦女為太子建妻。

translations.literal: Eleventh year, Chu Ping Wang came sought Qin woman as crown prince Jian wife.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year, King Ping of Chu came to seek a Qin woman as wife for crown prince Jian.

sentences.zh: 至國，女好而自娶之。

translations.literal: Arrived state, woman beautiful and self married her.
translations.idiomatic: When he arrived in the state, the woman was beautiful, and he married her himself.

sentences.zh: 十五年，楚平王欲誅建，建亡；

translations.literal: Fifteenth year, Chu Ping Wang wished execute Jian, Jian fled;
translations.idiomatic: In the fifteenth year, King Ping of Chu wished to execute Jian. Jian fled;

sentences.zh: 伍子胥奔吳。

translations.literal: wuzi Xu fled Wu.
translations.idiomatic: wuzi Xu fled to Wu.

sentences.zh: 晉公室卑而六卿彊，欲內相攻，是以久秦晉不相攻。

translations.literal: Jin ducal house low and six ministers strong, wished internally mutually attacked, therefore long Qin Jin not mutually attacked.
translations.idiomatic: The Jin ducal house was weak while the six ministers were strong. They wished to attack each other internally, which is why Qin and Jin did not attack each other for a long time.

sentences.zh: 三十一年，吳王闔閭與伍子胥伐楚，楚王亡奔隨，吳遂入郢。

translations.literal: Thirty-first year, Wu wang He Lu with wuzi Xu attacked Chu, Chu wang fled ran Sui, Wu then entered Ying.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-first year, King He Lu of Wu and wuzi Xu attacked Chu. The Chu king fled to Sui, and Wu then entered Ying.

sentences.zh: 楚大夫申包胥來告急，七日不食，日夜哭泣。

translations.literal: Chu grand master Shen Bao Xu came reported urgent, seven days not ate, day night wept.
translations.idiomatic: Chu's grand master Shen Bao Xu came to report the emergency. He did not eat for seven days, weeping day and night.

sentences.zh: 於是秦乃發五百乘救楚，敗吳師。

translations.literal: Then Qin then dispatched five hundred chariots rescued Chu, defeated Wu troops.
translations.idiomatic: Qin then dispatched five hundred chariots to rescue Chu and defeated the Wu troops.

sentences.zh: 吳師歸，楚昭王乃得復入郢。

translations.literal: Wu troops returned, Chu Zhao Wang then obtained again entered Ying.
translations.idiomatic: The Wu troops returned, and King Zhao of Chu was then able to re-enter Ying.

sentences.zh: 哀公立三十六年卒。

translations.literal: Ai Gong established thirty-six years died.
translations.idiomatic: Ai Gong ruled for thirty-six years and died.

sentences.zh: 太子夷公，夷公蚤死，不得立，立夷公子，是為惠公。

translations.literal: Crown prince Yi Gong, Yi Gong early died, not obtained established, established Yi Gong son, this Hui Gong.
translations.idiomatic: Crown prince Yi Gong died early and could not be established. They established Yi Gong's son, who was called Hui Gong.

sentences.zh: 惠公元年，孔子行魯相事。

translations.literal: Hui Gong first year, Confucius acted Lu chancellor matters.
translations.idiomatic: In Hui Gong's first year, Confucius acted as chancellor of Lu.

sentences.zh: 五年，晉卿中行、范氏反晉，晉使智氏、趙簡子攻之，范、中行氏亡奔齊。

translations.literal: Fifth year, Jin ministers Zhong Xing, Fan clan rebelled Jin, Jin made Zhi clan, Zhao Jianzi attacked them, Fan, Zhong Xing clan fled ran Qi.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year, Jin's ministers Zhonghang and the Fan clan rebelled against Jin. Jin sent the Zhi clan and Zhao Jianzi to attack them. The Fan and Zhonghang clans fled to Qi.

sentences.zh: 惠公立十年卒，子悼公立。

translations.literal: Hui Gong established ten years died, son Dao Gong established.
translations.idiomatic: Hui Gong ruled for ten years and died. His son Dao Gong was established.

sentences.zh: 悼公二年，齊臣田乞弒其君孺子，立其兄陽生，是為悼公。

translations.literal: Dao Gong second year, Qi minister Tian Qi assassinated his lord Ru Zi, established his brother Yang Sheng, this Dao Gong.
translations.idiomatic: In Dao Gong's second year, Qi's minister Tian Qi assassinated his lord Ru Zi and established his brother Yang Sheng, who was called Dao Gong.

sentences.zh: 六年，吳敗齊師。

translations.literal: Sixth year, Wu defeated Qi troops.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year, Wu defeated the Qi troops.

sentences.zh: 齊人弒悼公，立其子簡公。

translations.literal: Qi people assassinated Dao Gong, established his son Jian Gong.
translations.idiomatic: The Qi people assassinated Dao Gong and established his son Jian Gong.

sentences.zh: 九年，晉定公與吳王夫差盟，爭長於黃池，卒先吳。

translations.literal: Ninth year, Jin Ding Gong with Wu wang Fu Chai allied, contended precedence at Huang Chi, finally yielded to Wu.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year, Duke Ding of Jin made an alliance with King Fu Chai of Wu. They contended for precedence at Huang Chi, and Jin finally yielded to Wu.

sentences.zh: 吳彊，陵中國。

translations.literal: Wu strong, overawed central states.
translations.idiomatic: Wu was strong and overawed the central states.

sentences.zh: 十二年，齊田常弒簡公，立其弟平公，常相之。

translations.literal: Twelfth year, Qi Tian Chang assassinated Jian Gong, established his younger brother Ping Gong, Chang became chancellor.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth year, Tian Chang of Qi assassinated Jian Gong and established his younger brother Ping Gong. Chang became his chancellor.

sentences.zh: 十三年，楚滅陳。

translations.literal: Thirteenth year, Chu extinguished Chen.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year, Chu extinguished Chen.

sentences.zh: 秦悼公立十四年卒，子厲共公立。

translations.literal: Duke Dao of Qin established fourteen years died, son Duke Ligong established.
translations.idiomatic: Duke Dao of Qin ruled for fourteen years and died. His son Duke Ligong was established.

sentences.zh: 孔子以悼公十二年卒。

translations.literal: Confucius in Dao Gong twelfth year died.
translations.idiomatic: Confucius died in Dao Gong's twelfth year.

sentences.zh: 厲共公二年，蜀人來賂。

translations.literal: Duke Ligong second year, Shu people came bribed.
translations.idiomatic: In Duke Ligong's second year, the Shu people came with bribes.

sentences.zh: 十六年，塹河旁。

translations.literal: Sixteenth year, dug moats Yellow River side.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixteenth year, they dug moats along the Yellow River.

sentences.zh: 以兵二萬伐大荔，取其王城。

translations.literal: With troops twenty thousand attacked Da Li, took its wang city.
translations.idiomatic: They attacked Da Li with twenty thousand troops and took its royal city.

sentences.zh: 二十一年，初縣頻陽。

translations.literal: Twenty-first year, first established county Pin Yang.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-first year, they first established the county of Pin Yang.

sentences.zh: 晉取武成。

translations.literal: Jin took Wu Cheng.
translations.idiomatic: Jin took Wu Cheng.

sentences.zh: 二十四年，晉亂，殺智伯，分其國與趙、韓、魏。

translations.literal: Twenty-fourth year, Jin chaos, killed Zhi Bo, divided his state with Zhao, Han, Wei.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-fourth year, Jin fell into chaos. They killed Zhi Bo and divided his state among Zhao, Han, and Wei.

sentences.zh: 二十五年，智開與邑人來奔。

translations.literal: Twenty-fifth year, Zhi Kai with city people came fled.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-fifth year, Zhi Kai and the city people fled here.

sentences.zh: 三十三年，伐義渠，虜其王。

translations.literal: In the thirty-third year, they attacked Yiqu and captured its king.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-third year, Qin attacked Yiqu and captured its king.

sentences.zh: 三十四年，日食。

translations.literal: Thirty-fourth year, solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-fourth year, there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 厲共公卒，子躁公立。

translations.literal: Duke Ligong died, son Zhao Gong established.
translations.idiomatic: Duke Ligong died, and his son Zhao Gong was established.

sentences.zh: 躁公二年，南鄭反。

translations.literal: Zhao Gong second year, Nan Zheng rebelled.
translations.idiomatic: In Zhao Gong's second year, Nan Zheng rebelled.

sentences.zh: 十三年，義渠來伐，至渭南。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year, Yiqu came to attack and reached south of the Wei River.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year, Yiqu came to attack and reached the south bank of the Wei River.

sentences.zh: 十四年，躁公卒，立其弟懷公。

translations.literal: Fourteenth year, Zhao Gong died, established his younger brother Huai Gong.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourteenth year, Zhao Gong died, and they established his younger brother Huai Gong.

sentences.zh: 懷公四年，庶長朝與大臣圍懷公，懷公自殺。

translations.literal: In Duke Huai's fourth year, Shuzhang Zhao and the ministers surrounded Duke Huai, and Duke Huai committed suicide.
translations.idiomatic: In Duke Huai's fourth year, Shuzhang Zhao and the ministers surrounded Duke Huai, and Duke Huai killed himself.

sentences.zh: 懷公太子曰昭子，蚤死，大臣乃立太子昭子之子，是為靈公。

translations.literal: Huai Gong crown prince called Zhao Zi, early died, ministers then established crown prince Zhao Zi son, this Ling Gong.
translations.idiomatic: Huai Gong's crown prince was called Zhao Zi. He died early, so the ministers established Zhao Zi's son, who was called Ling Gong.

sentences.zh: 靈公，懷公孫也。

translations.literal: Ling Gong, Huai Gong grandson.
translations.idiomatic: Ling Gong was Huai Gong's grandson.

sentences.zh: 靈公六年，晉城少梁，秦擊之。

translations.literal: Ling Gong sixth year, Jin walled Shao Liang, Qin attacked it.
translations.idiomatic: In Ling Gong's sixth year, Jin fortified Shao Liang, and Qin attacked it.

sentences.zh: 十三年，城籍姑。

translations.literal: Thirteenth year, walled Ji Gu.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year, they walled Ji Gu.

sentences.zh: 靈公卒，子獻公不得立，立靈公季父悼子，是為簡公。

translations.literal: Ling Gong died, son Xian Gong not obtained established, established Ling Gong younger uncle Dao Zi, this Jian Gong.
translations.idiomatic: Ling Gong died. His son Xian Gong could not be established, so they established Ling Gong's younger uncle Dao Zi, who was called Jian Gong.

sentences.zh: 簡公，昭子之弟而懷公子也。

translations.literal: Jian Gong, Zhao Zi younger brother and Huai Gong son.
translations.idiomatic: Jian Gong was Zhao Zi's younger brother and Huai Gong's son.

sentences.zh: 簡公六年，令吏初帶劍。

translations.literal: Jian Gong sixth year, ordered officials first wore swords.
translations.idiomatic: In Jian Gong's sixth year, he ordered officials to first wear swords.

sentences.zh: 塹洛。

translations.literal: Dug moats Luo.
translations.idiomatic: They dug moats at Luo.

sentences.zh: 城重泉。

translations.literal: Walled Chong Quan.
translations.idiomatic: They walled Chong Quan.

sentences.zh: 十六年卒，子惠公立。

translations.literal: Sixteenth year died, son Hui Gong established.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixteenth year he died, and his son Hui Gong was established.

sentences.zh: 惠公十二年，子出子生。

translations.literal: Hui Gong twelfth year, son Chu Zi born.
translations.idiomatic: In Hui Gong's twelfth year, his son Chu Zi was born.

sentences.zh: 十三年，伐蜀，取南鄭。

translations.literal: Thirteenth year, attacked Shu, took Nan Zheng.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year, they attacked Shu and took Nan Zheng.

sentences.zh: 惠公卒，出子立。

translations.literal: Hui Gong died, Chu Zi established.
translations.idiomatic: Hui Gong died, and Chu Zi was established.

sentences.zh: 出子二年，庶長改迎靈公之子獻公于河西而立之。

translations.literal: In Chuzi's second year, Shuzhang Gai welcomed Duke Ling's son Duke Xian from west of the river and established him.
translations.idiomatic: In Chuzi's second year, Shuzhang Gai welcomed Duke Ling's son, Duke Xian, from west of the river and established him.

sentences.zh: 殺出子及其母，沈之淵旁。

translations.literal: Killed Chu Zi and his mother, drowned them beside the abyss.
translations.idiomatic: They killed Chu Zi and his mother, drowning them beside the abyss.

sentences.zh: 秦以往者數易君，君臣乖亂，故晉復彊，奪秦河西地。

translations.literal: Qin in past frequently changed lords, lord ministers discordant chaotic, therefore Jin again strong, took Qin He west lands.
translations.idiomatic: Qin had frequently changed lords in the past, with lords and ministers in discordant chaos, so Jin grew strong again and took Qin's lands west of the river.

sentences.zh: 獻公元年，止從死。

translations.literal: Xian Gong first year, stopped followers in death.
translations.idiomatic: In Xian Gong's first year, he stopped the practice of followers in death.

sentences.zh: 二年，城櫟陽。

translations.literal: In the second year, they walled Liyang.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year, they walled Liyang.

sentences.zh: 四年正月庚寅，孝公生。

translations.literal: Fourth year first month gengyin, Xiao Gong born.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year, first month, gengyin day, Xiao Gong was born.

sentences.zh: 十一年，周太史儋見獻公曰：「周故與秦國合而別，別五百歲復合，合

translations.literal: Eleventh year, Zhou grand scribe Dan saw Duke Xian said: 'Zhou formerly with Qin state joined then separated, separated five hundred years again joined, joined
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year, the Zhou grand historian Dan met Duke Xian and said: "Zhou and the state of Qin were once joined and then parted; five hundred years after parting they will join again; and after joining again,

translations.literal: (seven)
translations.idiomatic: (seven)

sentences.zh: 十七歲而霸王出。」

translations.literal: seventeen years then hegemon king arises.
translations.idiomatic: Seventeen years later, a hegemon-king will appear."

sentences.zh: 十六年，桃冬花。

translations.literal: Sixteenth year, peach winter flowered.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixteenth year, peaches flowered in winter.

sentences.zh: 十八年，雨金櫟陽。

translations.literal: In the eighteenth year, it rained gold at Liyang.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighteenth year, gold fell like rain at Liyang.

sentences.zh: 二十一年，與晉戰於石門，斬首六萬，天子賀以黼黻。

translations.literal: Twenty-first year, with Jin battled at Shi Men, beheaded sixty thousand, Son of Heaven congratulated with Fu Fu.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-first year, they battled with Jin at Shimen, beheading sixty thousand. The Son of Heaven congratulated them with ceremonial vestments.

sentences.zh: 二十三年，與魏晉戰少梁，虜其將公孫痤。

translations.literal: In the twenty-third year, they fought Wei and Jin at Shaoliang and captured their general Gongsun Cuo.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-third year, Qin fought Wei and Jin at Shaoliang and captured their general Gongsun Cuo.

sentences.zh: 二十四年，獻公卒，子孝公立，年已二十一歲矣。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fourth year, Duke Xian died, and his son Duke Xiao was established. He was already twenty-one years old.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-fourth year, Duke Xian died, and his son Duke Xiao came to the throne. He was already twenty-one years old.

sentences.zh: 孝公元年，河山以東彊國六，與齊威、楚宣、魏惠、燕悼、韓哀、趙成侯并。

translations.literal: In Duke Xiao’s first year, east of the Yellow River and Mount Hua there were six strong states: King Wei of Qi, King Xuan of Chu, King Hui of Wei, Marquis Dao of Yan, Marquis Ai of Han, and Marquis Cheng of Zhao.
translations.idiomatic: In Duke Xiao's first year, east of the Yellow River and Mount Hua there were six strong states: King Wei of Qi, King Xuan of Chu, King Hui of Wei, Marquis Dao of Yan, Marquis Ai of Han, and Marquis Cheng of Zhao.

sentences.zh: 淮泗之閒小國十餘。

translations.literal: Huai Si between small states ten remaining.
translations.idiomatic: Between the Huai and Si rivers there were more than ten small states.

sentences.zh: 楚、魏與秦接界。

translations.literal: Chu, Wei with Qin bordered.
translations.idiomatic: Chu and Wei bordered Qin.

sentences.zh: 魏筑長城，自鄭濱洛以北，有上郡。

translations.literal: Wei built a long wall extending from Zheng north along the Luo and held Shang Commandery.
translations.idiomatic: Wei built a long wall from Zheng northward along the Luo and occupied Shang Commandery.

sentences.zh: 楚自漢中，南有巴、黔中。

translations.literal: Chu held Hanzhong, and to the south it had Ba and Qianzhong.
translations.idiomatic: Chu held Hanzhong, with Ba and Qianzhong to the south.

sentences.zh: 周室微，諸侯力政，爭相併。

translations.literal: Zhou house weak, feudal lords force governed, contended mutually annexed.
translations.idiomatic: The Zhou house was weak. The feudal lords governed by force and contended to annex each other.

sentences.zh: 秦僻在雍州，不與中國諸侯之會盟，夷翟遇之。

translations.literal: Qin was remote in Yongzhou and did not take part in the alliance meetings of the feudal lords of the Central States, who treated it as Yi and Di barbarian territory.
translations.idiomatic: Qin lay remote in Yongzhou and did not take part in the alliance meetings of the feudal lords of the Central States, who treated it like Yi and Di barbarian territory.

sentences.zh: 孝公於是布惠，振孤寡，招戰士，明功賞。

translations.literal: Xiao Gong then spread favor, aided orphans widows, recruited warriors, clarified merit rewards.
translations.idiomatic: Xiao Gong then spread favor, aided orphans and widows, recruited warriors, and clarified merit and rewards.

sentences.zh: 下令國中曰：「昔我繆公自岐雍之閒，修德行武，東平晉亂，以河為界，西霸戎翟，廣地千里，天子致伯，諸侯畢賀，為後世開業，甚光美。

translations.literal: He issued an order throughout the state: “Formerly our Duke Mu, from the region between Qi and Yong, cultivated virtue and practiced warfare. To the east, he pacified Jin’s disorder, using the Yellow River as his boundary; to the west, he became hegemon over the Rong and Di, broadening his territory by a thousand li. The Son of Heaven conferred the hegemony on him, and all the feudal lords offered congratulations. He opened the enterprise for later generations, which was exceedingly glorious and splendid.
translations.idiomatic: He issued an order throughout the state: “Formerly our Duke Mu, from the region between Qi and Yong, cultivated virtue and practiced warfare. To the east, he pacified Jin's disorder, using the Yellow River as his boundary; to the west, he became hegemon over the Rong and Di, expanding his territory by a thousand li. The Son of Heaven conferred the hegemony on him, and all the feudal lords offered congratulations. He opened the enterprise for later generations, and it was exceedingly glorious.

sentences.zh: 會往者厲、躁、簡公、出子之不寧，國家內憂，未遑外事，三晉攻奪我先君河西地，諸侯卑秦、醜莫大焉。

translations.literal: But in the troubled times of Dukes Li, Zao, and Jian and of Chuzi, the state had internal worries and no leisure for external affairs. The Three Jin attacked and seized my former rulers’ lands west of the river, and the feudal lords looked down on Qin. No shame could be greater.
translations.idiomatic: But during the troubled times of Dukes Li, Zao, and Jian and of Chuzi, the state had internal worries and no leisure for external affairs. The Three Jin attacked and seized my former rulers' lands west of the river, and the feudal lords looked down on Qin. No shame could be greater.

sentences.zh: 獻公即位，鎮撫邊境，徙治櫟陽，且欲東伐，復繆公之故地，修繆公之政令。

translations.literal: When Duke Xian ascended the throne, he pacified the frontiers, moved the seat of government to Liyang, and wished to attack east, recover Duke Mu’s former lands, and restore Duke Mu’s policies and commands.
translations.idiomatic: When Duke Xian ascended the throne, he pacified the frontiers, moved the seat of government to Liyang, and wished to attack east, recover Duke Mu's former lands, and restore Duke Mu's policies and commands.

sentences.zh: 寡人思念先君之意，常痛於心。

translations.literal: When I think of my former rulers’ intentions, it always pains my heart.
translations.idiomatic: When I think of my former rulers' intentions, my heart is always pained.

sentences.zh: 賓客群臣有能出奇計彊秦者，吾且尊官，與之分土。」

translations.literal: If any guests or ministers can produce an extraordinary plan to strengthen Qin, I will honor him with office and share territory with him.”
translations.idiomatic: If any guest or minister can produce an extraordinary plan to strengthen Qin, I will honor him with office and share territory with him.”

sentences.zh: 於是乃出兵東圍陜城，西斬戎之獂王。

translations.literal: He then sent troops east to besiege Xiacheng and west to behead King Huan of the Rong.
translations.idiomatic: He then sent troops east to besiege Xiacheng and west to kill King Huan of the Rong.

sentences.zh: 衛鞅聞是令下，西入秦，因景監求見孝公。

translations.literal: Wei Yang heard that this order had been issued and entered Qin from the west. Through Jing Jian he sought an audience with Duke Xiao.
translations.idiomatic: Wei Yang heard that this order had been issued and went west into Qin. Through Jing Jian, he sought an audience with Duke Xiao.

sentences.zh: 二年，天子致胙。

translations.literal: Second year, Son of Heaven presented sacrificial meat.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year, the Son of Heaven presented sacrificial meat.

sentences.zh: 三年，衛鞅說孝公變法修刑，內務耕稼，外勸戰死之賞罰，孝公善之。

translations.literal: In the third year, Wei Yang persuaded Duke Xiao to change the laws and revise the punishments, encouraging farming within the state and establishing rewards and punishments for those who fought and died abroad. Duke Xiao approved of this.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year, Wei Yang persuaded Duke Xiao to reform the laws and revise the punishments, encouraging farming within the state and setting rewards and punishments for those who fought to the death abroad. Duke Xiao approved.

sentences.zh: 甘龍、杜摯等弗然，相與爭之。

translations.literal: Gan Long, Du Zhi, and others disagreed and argued against it together.
translations.idiomatic: Gan Long, Du Zhi, and others disagreed and argued against it.

sentences.zh: 卒用鞅法，百姓苦之；

translations.literal: Finally used Yang laws, common people suffered it;
translations.idiomatic: Finally, they used Yang's laws, and the common people suffered from them;

sentences.zh: 居三年，百姓便之。

translations.literal: Resided three years, common people convenient to them.
translations.idiomatic: After three years, the common people found them convenient.

sentences.zh: 乃拜鞅為左庶長。

translations.literal: He then appointed Yang as Left Shuzhang.
translations.idiomatic: He then appointed Yang as Left Shuzhang.

sentences.zh: 其事在商君語中。

translations.literal: His affairs are recorded in the biography of Lord Shang.
translations.idiomatic: His deeds are recorded in the biography of Lord Shang.

sentences.zh: 七年，與魏惠王會杜平。

translations.literal: Seventh year, with Wei Hui Wang met Du Ping.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year, he met with King Hui of Wei at Du Ping.

sentences.zh: 八年，與魏戰元裏，有功。

translations.literal: Eighth year, with Wei battled Yuan Li, had merit.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year, they battled with Wei at Yuan Li and had merit.

sentences.zh: 十年，衛鞅為大良造，將兵圍魏安邑，降之。

translations.literal: In the tenth year, Wei Yang became Grand Liangzao, led troops to surround Wei’s Anyi, and forced it to surrender.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year, Wei Yang became Grand Liangzao, led troops in surrounding Wei’s Anyi, and compelled its surrender.

sentences.zh: 十二年，作為咸陽，筑冀闕，秦徙都之。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year, they built Xianyang, constructed the palace gate towers, and Qin moved its capital there.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth year, they built Xianyang and its palace gate towers, and Qin moved the capital there.

sentences.zh: 并諸小鄉聚，集為大縣，縣一令，四十一縣。

translations.literal: Combined various small townships gathered, assembled as large counties, county one magistrate, forty-one counties.
translations.idiomatic: They combined the various small townships and gatherings into large counties, each county with one magistrate, making forty-one counties.

sentences.zh: 為田開阡陌。

translations.literal: For fields opened Qian Mo.
translations.idiomatic: For the fields they opened Qian Mo.

sentences.zh: 東地渡洛。

translations.literal: East lands crossed Luo.
translations.idiomatic: The eastern lands crossed the Luo.

sentences.zh: 十四年，初為賦。

translations.literal: Fourteenth year, first made taxes.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourteenth year, they first made taxes.

sentences.zh: 十九年，天子致伯。

translations.literal: Nineteenth year, Son of Heaven conferred hegemony.
translations.idiomatic: In the nineteenth year, the Son of Heaven conferred hegemony.

sentences.zh: 二十年，諸侯畢賀。

translations.literal: Twentieth year, feudal lords all congratulated.
translations.idiomatic: In the twentieth year, all the feudal lords congratulated him.

sentences.zh: 秦使公子少官率師會諸侯逢澤，朝天子。

translations.literal: Qin made nobleman Shao Guan lead troops assembled feudal lords Feng Ze, audience Son of Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: Qin had nobleman Shao Guan lead troops to assemble the feudal lords at Feng Ze for an audience with the Son of Heaven.

sentences.zh: 二十一年，齊敗魏馬陵。

translations.literal: Twenty-first year, Qi defeated Wei Ma Ling.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-first year, Qi defeated Wei at Ma Ling.

sentences.zh: 二十二年，衛鞅擊魏，虜魏公子卬。

translations.literal: Twenty-second year, Wei Yang attacked Wei, captured Wei nobleman Ang.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-second year, Wei Yang attacked Wei and captured Wei's nobleman Ang.

sentences.zh: 封鞅為列侯，號商君。

translations.literal: Enfeoffed Yang as lie hou, titled Shang Jun.
translations.idiomatic: He enfeoffed Yang as a lie hou and titled him Shang Jun.

sentences.zh: 二十四年，與晉戰雁門，虜其將魏錯。

translations.literal: Twenty-fourth year, with Jin battled Yan Men, captured their general Wei Cuo.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-fourth year, they battled with Jin at Yan Men and captured their general Wei Cuo.

sentences.zh: 孝公卒，子惠文君立。

translations.literal: Duke Xiao died, and his son Lord Huiwen was established.
translations.idiomatic: Duke Xiao died, and his son, Lord Huiwen, took the throne.

sentences.zh: 是歲，誅衛鞅。

translations.literal: This year, executed Wei Yang.
translations.idiomatic: In this year, they executed Wei Yang.

sentences.zh: 鞅之初為秦施法，法不行，太子犯禁。

translations.literal: Yang initially for Qin applied laws, laws not carried out, crown prince violated prohibitions.
translations.idiomatic: When Yang first applied laws for Qin, the laws were not carried out, and the crown prince violated the prohibitions.

sentences.zh: 鞅曰：「法之不行，自於貴戚。

translations.literal: Yang said: 'Laws not carried out, from noble relatives.
translations.idiomatic: Yang said: 'The laws are not carried out because of the noble relatives.

sentences.zh: 君必欲行法，先於太子。

translations.literal: Lord must wish carry out laws, first at crown prince.
translations.idiomatic: If your lordship must carry out the laws, start with the crown prince.

sentences.zh: 太子不可黥，黥其傅師。」

translations.literal: Crown prince cannot tattoo, tattoo his tutor master.'
translations.idiomatic: The crown prince cannot be tattooed, so tattoo his tutor master.'

sentences.zh: 於是法大用，秦人治。

translations.literal: Then laws greatly used, Qin people governed.
translations.idiomatic: Then the laws were greatly used, and the Qin people were governed.

sentences.zh: 及孝公卒，太子立，宗室多怨鞅，鞅亡，因以為反，而卒車裂以徇秦國。

translations.literal: Reached Xiao Gong died, crown prince established, clan residence many resented Yang, Yang fled, therefore regarded as rebellion, and finally chariot tore to make example Qin state.
translations.idiomatic: When Duke Xiao died and the crown prince was established, many members of the ruling clan resented Yang. Yang fled, so they regarded him as a rebel, and finally tore him apart with chariots as a warning throughout the Qin state.

sentences.zh: 惠文君元年，楚、韓、趙、蜀人來朝。

translations.literal: In Lord Huiwen’s first year, people from Chu, Han, Zhao, and Shu came for audience.
translations.idiomatic: In Lord Huiwen’s first year, envoys from Chu, Han, Zhao, and Shu came to court.

sentences.zh: 二年，天子賀。

translations.literal: Second year, Son of Heaven congratulated.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year, the Son of Heaven congratulated.

sentences.zh: 三年，王冠。

translations.literal: In the third year, the king was capped.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year, the king underwent the capping ceremony.

sentences.zh: 四年，天子致文武胙。

translations.literal: Fourth year, Son of Heaven presented civil martial sacrificial meat.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year, the Son of Heaven presented civil and martial sacrificial meat.

sentences.zh: 齊、魏為王。

translations.literal: Qi and Wei assumed the title of king.
translations.idiomatic: Qi and Wei each adopted the royal title.

sentences.zh: 五年，陰晉人犀首為大良造。

translations.literal: In the fifth year, Xi Shou of Yinjin became Grand Liangzao.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year, Xi Shou of Yinjin was made Grand Liangzao.

sentences.zh: 六年，魏納陰晉，陰晉更名寧秦。

translations.literal: Sixth year, Wei took Yin Jin, Yin Jin changed name Ning Qin.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year, Wei took Yin Jin, and Yin Jin changed its name to Ning Qin.

sentences.zh: 七年，公子卬與魏戰，虜其將龍賈，斬首八萬。

translations.literal: Seventh year, nobleman Ang with Wei battled, captured their general Long Jia, beheaded eighty thousand.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year, nobleman Ang battled with Wei, captured their general Long Jia, and beheaded eighty thousand.

sentences.zh: 八年，魏納河西地。

translations.literal: Eighth year, Wei took He west lands.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year, Wei took the lands west of the river.

sentences.zh: 九年，渡河，取汾陰、皮氏。

translations.literal: Ninth year, crossed river, took Fen Yin, Pi Shi.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year, they crossed the river and took Fen Yin and Pi Shi.

sentences.zh: 與魏王會應。

translations.literal: He met with the King of Wei at Ying.
translations.idiomatic: He met the King of Wei at Ying.

sentences.zh: 圍焦，降之。

translations.literal: Surrounded Jiao, surrendered it.
translations.idiomatic: They surrounded Jiao and surrendered it.

sentences.zh: 十年，張儀相秦。

translations.literal: Tenth year, Zhang Yi became chancellor Qin.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year, Zhang Yi became chancellor of Qin.

sentences.zh: 魏納上郡十五縣。

translations.literal: Wei surrendered fifteen counties of Shang Commandery.
translations.idiomatic: Wei surrendered fifteen counties of Shang Commandery.

sentences.zh: 十一年，縣義渠。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year, they established Yiqu as a county.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year, Qin made Yiqu a county.

sentences.zh: 歸魏焦、曲沃。

translations.literal: Returned Wei Jiao, Qu Wo.
translations.idiomatic: They returned Jiao and Qu Wo to Wei.

sentences.zh: 義渠君為臣。

translations.literal: The lord of Yiqu became a minister.
translations.idiomatic: The lord of Yiqu became a minister.

sentences.zh: 更名少梁曰夏陽。

translations.literal: Changed name Shao Liang called Xia Yang.
translations.idiomatic: They changed the name of Shao Liang to Xia Yang.

sentences.zh: 十二年，初臘。

translations.literal: Twelfth year, first la sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth year, they first performed the la sacrifice.

sentences.zh: 十三年四月戊午，魏君為王，韓亦為王。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year, in the fourth month, on the wuwu day, the lord of Wei became king, and Han also became king.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year, in the fourth month on the wuwu day, the lord of Wei became king; Han also claimed the royal title.

sentences.zh: 使張儀伐取陜，出其人與魏。

translations.literal: Made Zhang Yi attack took Xia, moved its people gave Wei.
translations.idiomatic: They had Zhang Yi attack and take Xia, and moved its people to give to Wei.

sentences.zh: 十四年，更為元年。

translations.literal: Fourteenth year, changed to first year.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourteenth year, they changed it to the first year.

sentences.zh: 二年，張儀與齊、楚大臣會齧桑。

translations.literal: Second year, Zhang Yi with Qi, Chu ministers met Nie Sang.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year, Zhang Yi met with ministers of Qi and Chu at Nie Sang.

sentences.zh: 三年，韓、魏太子來朝。

translations.literal: Third year, Han, Wei crown princes came audience.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year, the crown princes of Han and Wei came for audience.

sentences.zh: 張儀相魏。

translations.literal: Zhang Yi became chancellor Wei.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Yi became chancellor of Wei.

sentences.zh: 五年，王游至北河。

translations.literal: In the fifth year, the king toured as far as Beihe.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year, the king made a tour as far as Beihe.

sentences.zh: 七年，樂池相秦。

translations.literal: Seventh year, Le Chi became chancellor Qin.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year, Le Chi became chancellor of Qin.

sentences.zh: 韓、趙、魏、燕、齊帥匈奴共攻秦。

translations.literal: Han, Zhao, Wei, Yan, Qi led Xiongnu together attacked Qin.
translations.idiomatic: Han, Zhao, Wei, Yan, and Qi led the Xiongnu in a joint attack on Qin.

sentences.zh: 秦使庶長疾與戰修魚，虜其將申差，敗趙公子渴、韓太子奐，斬首八萬二千。

translations.literal: Qin had Shuzhang Ji battle with them at Xiuyu, captured their general Shen Chai, defeated Zhao's nobleman Ke and Han's crown prince Huan, and beheaded eighty-two thousand.
translations.idiomatic: Qin sent Shuzhang Ji to fight them at Xiuyu; he captured their general Shen Chai, defeated Prince Ke of Zhao and Crown Prince Huan of Han, and took eighty-two thousand heads.

sentences.zh: 八年，張儀復相秦。

translations.literal: Eighth year, Zhang Yi again became chancellor Qin.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year, Zhang Yi again became chancellor of Qin.

sentences.zh: 九年，司馬錯伐蜀，滅之。

translations.literal: In the ninth year, Sima Cuo attacked Shu and extinguished it.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year, Sima Cuo attacked Shu and destroyed it.

sentences.zh: 伐取趙中都、西陽十年，韓太子蒼來質。

translations.literal: They attacked and took Zhao's Zhongdu and Xiyang. In the tenth year, Han's crown prince Cang came as hostage.
translations.idiomatic: They attacked Zhao and captured Zhongdu and Xiyang. In the tenth year, Crown Prince Cang of Han came as a hostage.

sentences.zh: 伐取韓石章。

translations.literal: They attacked and captured Shizhang from Han.
translations.idiomatic: They attacked and captured Shizhang from Han.

sentences.zh: 伐敗趙將泥。

translations.literal: Attacked defeated Zhao general Ni.
translations.idiomatic: They attacked and defeated Zhao's general Ni.

sentences.zh: 伐取義渠二十五城。

translations.literal: They attacked and took twenty-five cities of Yiqu.
translations.idiomatic: They attacked Yiqu and took twenty-five cities.

sentences.zh: 十一年，摢裏疾攻魏焦，降之。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year, Chuli Ji attacked Wei's Jiao and forced it to surrender.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year, Chuli Ji attacked Wei’s Jiao and compelled its surrender.

sentences.zh: 敗韓岸門，斬首萬，其將犀首走。

translations.literal: Defeated Han An Men, beheaded ten thousand, their general Xi Shou fled.
translations.idiomatic: They defeated Han at Anmen, beheaded ten thousand, and their general Xi Shou fled.

sentences.zh: 公子通封於蜀。

translations.literal: Nobleman Tong enfeoffed at Shu.
translations.idiomatic: Nobleman Tong was enfeoffed at Shu.

sentences.zh: 燕君讓其臣子之。

translations.literal: Yan lord yielded his minister son it.
translations.idiomatic: The Yan lord yielded it to his minister's son.

sentences.zh: 十二年，王與梁王會臨晉。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year, the king met with the King of Liang at Linjin.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth year, the king met the King of Liang at Linjin.

sentences.zh: 庶長疾攻趙，虜趙將莊。

translations.literal: Shuzhang Ji attacked Zhao and captured Zhao's general Zhuang.
translations.idiomatic: Shuzhang Ji attacked Zhao and captured its general Zhuang.

sentences.zh: 張儀相楚。

translations.literal: Zhang Yi became chancellor Chu.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Yi became chancellor of Chu.

sentences.zh: 十三年，庶長章擊楚於丹陽，虜其將屈丐，斬首八萬；

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year, Shuzhang Zhang attacked Chu at Danyang, captured their general Qu Gai, and beheaded eighty thousand;
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year, Shuzhang Zhang struck Chu at Danyang, captured its general Qu Gai, and took eighty thousand heads;

sentences.zh: 又攻楚漢中，取地六百里，置漢中郡。

translations.literal: They again attacked Chu’s Hanzhong, took six hundred li of land, and established Hanzhong Commandery.
translations.idiomatic: They attacked Chu’s Hanzhong again, seized six hundred li of territory, and established Hanzhong Commandery.

sentences.zh: 楚圍雍氏，秦使庶長疾助韓而東攻齊，到滿助魏攻燕。

translations.literal: Chu surrounded Yongshi. Qin had Shuzhang Ji assist Han and attack Qi to the east, and Dao Man assist Wei and attack Yan.
translations.idiomatic: Chu besieged Yongshi. Qin sent Shuzhang Ji to aid Han and attack Qi in the east, and sent Dao Man to aid Wei against Yan.

sentences.zh: 十四年，伐楚，取召陵。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year, they attacked Chu and took Zhaoling.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourteenth year, Qin attacked Chu and captured Zhaoling.

sentences.zh: 丹、犁臣，蜀相壯殺蜀侯來降。

translations.literal: Dan and Li became ministers. Shu's chancellor Zhuang killed the Marquis of Shu and came to surrender.
translations.idiomatic: Dan and Li became ministers. Zhuang, the chancellor of Shu, killed the Marquis of Shu and came over in surrender.

sentences.zh: 惠王卒，子武王立。

translations.literal: King Hui died, and his son King Wu was established.
translations.idiomatic: King Hui died, and his son King Wu took the throne.

sentences.zh: 韓、魏、齊、楚、越皆賓從。

translations.literal: Han, Wei, Qi, Chu, Yue all guest followed.
translations.idiomatic: Han, Wei, Qi, Chu, and Yue all followed as guests.

sentences.zh: 武王元年，與魏惠王會臨晉。

translations.literal: In King Wu’s first year, he met with King Hui of Wei at Linjin.
translations.idiomatic: In King Wu’s first year, he met King Hui of Wei at Linjin.

sentences.zh: 誅蜀相壯。

translations.literal: Executed Shu chancellor Zhuang.
translations.idiomatic: They executed Shu's chancellor Zhuang.

sentences.zh: 張儀、魏章皆東出之魏。

translations.literal: Zhang Yi, Wei Zhang all east went to Wei.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Yi and Wei Zhang all went east to Wei.

sentences.zh: 伐義渠、丹、犁。

translations.literal: They attacked Yiqu, Dan, and Li.
translations.idiomatic: They attacked Yiqu, Dan, and Li.

sentences.zh: 二年，初置丞相，摢裏疾、甘茂為左右丞相。

translations.literal: In the second year, they first established the position of chancellor. Chuli Ji and Gan Mao became chancellors of the left and right.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year, Qin first created the office of chancellor. Chuli Ji and Gan Mao became chancellors of the left and right.

sentences.zh: 張儀死於魏。

translations.literal: Zhang Yi died in Wei.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Yi died in Wei.

sentences.zh: 三年，與韓襄王會臨晉外。

translations.literal: In the third year, he met with King Xiang of Han outside Linjin.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year, he met King Xiang of Han outside Linjin.

sentences.zh: 南公揭卒，摢裏疾相韓。

translations.literal: Nangong Jie died, and Chuli Ji became chancellor of Han.
translations.idiomatic: Nangong Jie died, and Chuli Ji became chancellor in Han.

sentences.zh: 武王謂甘茂曰：「寡人欲容車通三川，窺周室，死不恨矣。」

translations.literal: King Wu told Gan Mao: “I want to open chariot passage through Sanchuan and look upon the Zhou royal house. If I die after that, I will have no regret.”
translations.idiomatic: King Wu said to Gan Mao, “I want to open a chariot road through Sanchuan and look upon the Zhou royal house. If I die after that, I will have no regret.”

sentences.zh: 其秋，使甘茂、庶長封伐宜陽。

translations.literal: That autumn, he had Gan Mao and Shuzhang Feng attack Yiyang.
translations.idiomatic: That autumn, the king ordered Gan Mao and Shuzhang Feng to attack Yiyang.

sentences.zh: 四年，拔宜陽，斬首六萬。

translations.literal: In the fourth year, they captured Yiyang and beheaded sixty thousand.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year, they captured Yiyang and took sixty thousand heads.

sentences.zh: 涉河，城武遂。

translations.literal: Crossed river, walled Wu Sui.
translations.idiomatic: They crossed the river and walled Wu Sui.

sentences.zh: 魏太子來朝。

translations.literal: Wei crown prince came audience.
translations.idiomatic: The Wei crown prince came for audience.

sentences.zh: 武王有力好戲，力士任鄙、烏獲、孟說皆至大官。

translations.literal: King Wu was strong and loved contests. The strong men Ren Bi, Wu Huo, and Meng Yue all rose to high office.
translations.idiomatic: King Wu was physically powerful and delighted in contests of strength; strongmen such as Ren Bi, Wu Huo, and Meng Yue all rose to high office.

sentences.zh: 王與孟說舉鼎，絕臏。

translations.literal: The king lifted a cauldron with Meng Yue and broke his shin.
translations.idiomatic: The king tried to lift a cauldron with Meng Yue and broke his shin.

sentences.zh: 八月，武王死。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, King Wu died.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, King Wu died.

sentences.zh: 族孟說。

translations.literal: Clan executed Meng Yue.
translations.idiomatic: They clan-executed Meng Yue.

sentences.zh: 武王取魏女為后，無子。

translations.literal: King Wu took a woman of Wei as queen, but had no sons.
translations.idiomatic: King Wu took a woman from Wei as queen, but had no sons.

sentences.zh: 立異母弟，是為昭襄王。

translations.literal: They established his younger half-brother, who became King Zhaoxiang.
translations.idiomatic: His younger half-brother was installed and became King Zhaoxiang.

sentences.zh: 昭襄母楚人，姓羋氏，號宣太后。

translations.literal: Zhao Xiang mother Chu person, surname Mi clan, titled Xuan empress dowager.
translations.idiomatic: Zhao Xiang's mother was a Chu person, of the Mi clan, and titled Xuan Empress Dowager.

sentences.zh: 武王死時，昭襄王為質於燕，燕人送歸，得立。

translations.literal: When King Wu died, King Zhaoxiang was a hostage in Yan. The people of Yan sent him back, and he was able to take the throne.
translations.idiomatic: When King Wu died, King Zhaoxiang was serving as a hostage in Yan. The people of Yan sent him back, allowing him to take the throne.

sentences.zh: 昭襄王元年，嚴君疾為相。

translations.literal: In King Zhaoxiang’s first year, Lord Yan Ji became chancellor.
translations.idiomatic: In King Zhaoxiang’s first year, Lord Yan Ji was made chancellor.

sentences.zh: 甘茂出之魏。

translations.literal: Gan Mao went to Wei.
translations.idiomatic: Gan Mao went to Wei.

sentences.zh: 二年，彗星見。

translations.literal: Second year, comet appeared.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year, a comet appeared.

sentences.zh: 庶長壯與大臣、諸侯、公子為逆，皆誅，及惠文后皆不得良死。

translations.literal: Shuzhang Zhuang rebelled with ministers, feudal lords, and noblemen. They were all executed, and even Empress Huiwen did not obtain a good death.
translations.idiomatic: Shuzhang Zhuang rebelled together with ministers, feudal lords, and princes. They were all executed, and even Empress Huiwen came to a bad end.

sentences.zh: 悼武王后出歸魏。

translations.literal: The queen of King Daowu left and returned to Wei.
translations.idiomatic: King Daowu’s queen left Qin and returned to Wei.

sentences.zh: 三年，王冠。

translations.literal: In the third year, the king was capped.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year, the king underwent the capping ceremony.

sentences.zh: 與楚王會黃棘，與楚上庸。

translations.literal: He met with the King of Chu at Huangji and gave Shangyong to Chu.
translations.idiomatic: He met the King of Chu at Huangji and gave Shangyong to Chu.

sentences.zh: 四年，取蒲阪。

translations.literal: In the fourth year, they took Puban.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year, they took Puban.

sentences.zh: 彗星見。

translations.literal: Comet appeared.
translations.idiomatic: A comet appeared.

sentences.zh: 五年，魏王來朝應亭，復與魏蒲阪。

translations.literal: In the fifth year, the King of Wei came for audience at Yingting, and Qin again gave Puban to Wei.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year, the King of Wei came to court at Yingting, and Qin again gave Puban back to Wei.

sentences.zh: 六年，蜀侯煇反，司馬錯定蜀。

translations.literal: In the sixth year, Marquis Hui of Shu rebelled, and Sima Cuo pacified Shu.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year, Marquis Hui of Shu rebelled, and Sima Cuo brought Shu back under control.

sentences.zh: 庶長奐伐楚，斬首二萬。

translations.literal: Shuzhang Huan attacked Chu and beheaded twenty thousand.
translations.idiomatic: Shuzhang Huan attacked Chu and took twenty thousand heads.

sentences.zh: 涇陽君質於齊。

translations.literal: Lord Jingyang was a hostage in Qi.
translations.idiomatic: Lord Jingyang was a hostage in Qi.

sentences.zh: 日食，晝晦。

translations.literal: Solar eclipse, daytime dark.
translations.idiomatic: There was a solar eclipse, and daytime was dark.

sentences.zh: 七年，拔新城。

translations.literal: In the seventh year, they captured Xincheng.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year, they captured Xincheng.

sentences.zh: 摢裏子卒。

translations.literal: Chuli Ji died.
translations.idiomatic: Chuli Ji died.

sentences.zh: 八年，使將軍羋戎攻楚，取新市。

translations.literal: In the eighth year, he had General Mi Rong attack Chu and take Xinshi.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year, the king sent General Mi Rong to attack Chu and capture Xinshi.

sentences.zh: 齊使章子，魏使公孫喜，韓使暴鳶共攻楚方城，取唐眛。

translations.literal: Qi sent Zhang Zi, Wei sent Gongsun Xi, and Han sent Bao Yuan to attack Chu's Fangcheng together and take Tangmian.
translations.idiomatic: Qi sent Zhang Zi, Wei sent Gongsun Xi, and Han sent Bao Yuan; together they attacked Chu’s Fangcheng and captured Tangmian.

sentences.zh: 趙破中山，其君亡，竟死齊。

translations.literal: Zhao broke Zhong Shan, its lord fled, finally died Qi.
translations.idiomatic: Zhao broke Zhongshan. Its lord fled and finally died in Qi.

sentences.zh: 魏公子勁、韓公子長為諸侯。

translations.literal: Wei nobleman Jing, Han nobleman Chang became feudal lords.
translations.idiomatic: Wei nobleman Jing and Han nobleman Chang became feudal lords.

sentences.zh: 九年，孟嘗君薛文來相秦。

translations.literal: In the ninth year, Lord Mengchang, Tian Wen, came to serve as chancellor of Qin.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year, Lord Mengchang, Tian Wen, came to Qin to serve as chancellor.

sentences.zh: 奐攻楚，取八城，殺其將景快。

translations.literal: Huan attacked Chu, took eight cities, killed their general Jing Kuai.
translations.idiomatic: Huan attacked Chu, took eight cities, and killed their general Jing Kuai.

sentences.zh: 十年，楚懷王入朝秦，秦留之。

translations.literal: In the tenth year, King Huai of Chu came to Qin for an audience, and Qin detained him.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year, King Huai of Chu came to Qin for audience, and Qin detained him.

sentences.zh: 薛文以金受免。

translations.literal: Tian Wen received gold and was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: Tian Wen received gold and was dismissed.

sentences.zh: 樓緩為丞相。

translations.literal: Lou Huan became chancellor.
translations.idiomatic: Lou Huan became chancellor.

sentences.zh: 十一年，齊、韓、魏、趙、宋、中山五國共攻秦，至鹽氏而還。

translations.literal: Eleventh year, Qi, Han, Wei, Zhao, Song, Zhong Shan five states together attacked Qin, reached Yan Shi then returned.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year, Qi, Han, Wei, Zhao, Song, and Zhongshan, five states in all, attacked Qin together. They reached Yanshi and then returned.

sentences.zh: 秦與韓、魏河北及封陵以和。

translations.literal: Qin made peace with Han and Wei at Hebei and Fengling.
translations.idiomatic: Qin concluded peace with Han and Wei at Hebei and Fengling.

sentences.zh: 彗星見。

translations.literal: Comet appeared.
translations.idiomatic: A comet appeared.

sentences.zh: 楚懷王走之趙，趙不受，還之秦，即死，歸葬。

translations.literal: King Huai of Chu fled to Zhao, but Zhao did not accept him. He returned to Qin, died soon after, and was sent back for burial.
translations.idiomatic: King Huai of Chu fled to Zhao, but Zhao refused to receive him. He returned to Qin, soon died, and was sent home for burial.

sentences.zh: 十二年，樓緩免，穰侯魏冉為相。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year, Lou Huan was dismissed, and Marquis Rang Wei Ran became chancellor.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth year, Lou Huan was dismissed, and Marquis Rang, Wei Ran, became chancellor.

sentences.zh: 予楚粟五萬石。

translations.literal: Gave Chu millet fifty thousand shi.
translations.idiomatic: They gave Chu fifty thousand shi of millet.

sentences.zh: 十三年，向壽伐韓，取武始。

translations.literal: Thirteenth year, Xiang Shou attacked Han, took Wu Shi.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year, Xiang Shou attacked Han and took Wu Shi.

sentences.zh: 左更白起攻新城。

translations.literal: Left Geng Bai Qi attacked Xincheng.
translations.idiomatic: Left Geng Bai Qi attacked Xincheng.

sentences.zh: 五大夫禮出亡奔魏。

translations.literal: Fifth-rank Grandee Li fled to Wei.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth-rank Grandee Li fled to Wei.

sentences.zh: 任鄙為漢中守。

translations.literal: Ren Bi became governor of Hanzhong.
translations.idiomatic: Ren Bi became governor of Hanzhong.

sentences.zh: 十四年，左更白起攻韓、魏於伊闕，斬首二十四萬，虜公孫喜，拔五城。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year, Left Geng Bai Qi attacked Han and Wei at Yique, beheaded two hundred forty thousand, captured Gongsun Xi, and seized five cities.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourteenth year, Left Geng Bai Qi attacked Han and Wei at Yique, took two hundred forty thousand heads, captured Gongsun Xi, and seized five cities.

sentences.zh: 十五年，大良造白起攻魏，取垣，復予之。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year, Grand Liangzao Bai Qi attacked Wei, took Yuan, and then returned it.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifteenth year, Grand Liangzao Bai Qi attacked Wei, took Yuan, and then gave it back.

sentences.zh: 攻楚，取宛。

translations.literal: Attacked Chu, took Wan.
translations.idiomatic: They attacked Chu and took Wan.

sentences.zh: 十六年，左更錯取軹及鄧。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year, Left Geng Cuo took Zhi and Deng.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixteenth year, Left Geng Cuo captured Zhi and Deng.

sentences.zh: 冉免，封公子市宛，公子悝鄧，魏冉陶，為諸侯。

translations.literal: Ran dismissed, enfeoffed nobleman Shi Wan, nobleman Kui Deng, Wei Ran Tao, became feudal lords.
translations.idiomatic: Ran was dismissed. They enfeoffed nobleman Shi at Wan, nobleman Kui at Deng, and Wei Ran at Tao, making them feudal lords.

sentences.zh: 十七年，城陽君入朝，及東周君來朝。

translations.literal: In the seventeenth year, Lord Chengyang came to court, and the Lord of Eastern Zhou also came to court.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventeenth year, Lord Chengyang came to court, as did the Lord of Eastern Zhou.

sentences.zh: 秦以垣為蒲阪、皮氏。

translations.literal: Qin made Yuan into Puban and Pishi.
translations.idiomatic: Qin made Yuan into Puban and Pishi.

sentences.zh: 王之宜陽。

translations.literal: The king went to Yiyang.
translations.idiomatic: The king went to Yiyang.

sentences.zh: 十八年，錯攻垣、河雍，決橋取之。

translations.literal: In the eighteenth year, Cuo attacked Yuan and Heyong, broke the bridge, and took the city.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighteenth year, Cuo attacked Yuan and Heyong, destroyed the bridge, and captured the city.

sentences.zh: 十九年，王為西帝，齊為東帝，皆復去之。

translations.literal: In the nineteenth year, the king became Western Emperor and Qi became Eastern Emperor, but both later abandoned these titles.
translations.idiomatic: In the nineteenth year, the king assumed the title Western Emperor and Qi assumed Eastern Emperor, though both soon abandoned the titles.

sentences.zh: 呂禮來自歸。

translations.literal: Lu Li came self surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: Lu Li came and surrendered himself.

sentences.zh: 齊破宋，宋王在魏，死溫。

translations.literal: Qi defeated Song. The King of Song was in Wei and died at Wen.
translations.idiomatic: Qi defeated Song. The King of Song fled to Wei and died at Wen.

sentences.zh: 任鄙卒。

translations.literal: Ren Bi died.
translations.idiomatic: Ren Bi died.

sentences.zh: 二十年，王之漢中，又之上郡、北河。

translations.literal: In the twentieth year, the king went to Hanzhong, and then went to Shang Commandery and Beihe.
translations.idiomatic: In the twentieth year, the king went to Hanzhong, then continued to Shang Commandery and Beihe.

sentences.zh: 二十一年，錯攻魏河內。

translations.literal: In the twenty-first year, Cuo attacked Wei's Henei.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-first year, Cuo attacked Wei’s Henei.

sentences.zh: 魏獻安邑，秦出其人，募徙河東賜爵，赦罪人遷之。

translations.literal: Wei offered Anyi. Qin moved its people out, recruited migrants to Hedong and granted them ranks of nobility, then pardoned criminals and moved them there.
translations.idiomatic: Wei offered Anyi. Qin removed its inhabitants, recruited migrants to Hedong and granted them ranks, then pardoned criminals and resettled them there.

sentences.zh: 涇陽君封宛。

translations.literal: Lord Jingyang was enfeoffed at Wan.
translations.idiomatic: Lord Jingyang was enfeoffed at Wan.

sentences.zh: 二十二年，蒙武伐齊。

translations.literal: Twenty-second year, Meng Wu attacked Qi.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-second year, Meng Wu attacked Qi.

sentences.zh: 河東為九縣。

translations.literal: Hedong became nine counties.
translations.idiomatic: Hedong became nine counties.

sentences.zh: 與楚王會宛。

translations.literal: He met with the King of Chu at Wan.
translations.idiomatic: He met the King of Chu at Wan.

sentences.zh: 與趙王會中陽。

translations.literal: He met with the King of Zhao at Zhongyang.
translations.idiomatic: He met the King of Zhao at Zhongyang.

sentences.zh: 二十三年，尉斯離與三晉、燕伐齊，破之濟西。

translations.literal: In the twenty-third year, Wei Sili, together with the Three Jin and Yan, attacked Qi and defeated it west of the Ji River.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-third year, Wei Sili joined the Three Jin and Yan in attacking Qi, defeating it west of the Ji River.

sentences.zh: 王與魏王會宜陽，與韓王會新城。

translations.literal: The king met with the King of Wei at Yiyang and with the King of Han at Xincheng.
translations.idiomatic: The king met the King of Wei at Yiyang and the King of Han at Xincheng.

sentences.zh: 二十四年，與楚王會鄢，又會穰。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fourth year, he met with the King of Chu at Yan and again at Rang.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-fourth year, he met the King of Chu at Yan and again at Rang.

sentences.zh: 秦取魏安城，至大梁，燕、趙救之，秦軍去。

translations.literal: Qin took Wei’s Ancheng and reached Daliang. Yan and Zhao came to Wei’s rescue, and the Qin army withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: Qin captured Wei’s Ancheng and advanced as far as Daliang. Yan and Zhao came to Wei’s aid, and the Qin army withdrew.

sentences.zh: 魏冉免相。

translations.literal: Wei Ran dismissed chancellor.
translations.idiomatic: Wei Ran was dismissed as chancellor.

sentences.zh: 二十五年，拔趙二城。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fifth year, they captured two cities from Zhao.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-fifth year, Qin captured two Zhao cities.

sentences.zh: 與韓王會新城，與魏王會新明邑。

translations.literal: He met with the King of Han at Xincheng and with the King of Wei at Xinmingyi.
translations.idiomatic: He met the King of Han at Xincheng and the King of Wei at Xinmingyi.

sentences.zh: 二十六年，赦罪人遷之穰。

translations.literal: In the twenty-sixth year, they pardoned criminals and moved them to Rang.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-sixth year, they pardoned criminals and moved them to the city of Rang.

sentences.zh: 侯冉復相。

translations.literal: Hou Ran again became chancellor.
translations.idiomatic: Hou Ran again became chancellor.

sentences.zh: 二十七年，錯攻楚。

translations.literal: Twenty-seventh year, Cuo attacked Chu.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-seventh year, Cuo attacked Chu.

sentences.zh: 赦罪人遷之南陽。

translations.literal: They pardoned criminals and moved them to Nanyang.
translations.idiomatic: They pardoned criminals and resettled them in Nanyang.

sentences.zh: 白起攻趙，取代光狼城。

translations.literal: Bai Qi attacked Zhao and took Daiguanglang city.
translations.idiomatic: Bai Qi attacked Zhao and captured Daiguanglang.

sentences.zh: 又使司馬錯發隴西，因蜀攻楚黔中，拔之。

translations.literal: They again had Sima Cuo set out from Longxi, attack Chu's Qianzhong through Shu, and seize it.
translations.idiomatic: Qin again had Sima Cuo set out from Longxi, pass through Shu to attack Chu’s Qianzhong, and seize it.

sentences.zh: 二十八年，大良造白起攻楚，取鄢、鄧，赦罪人遷之。

translations.literal: In the twenty-eighth year, Grand Liangzao Bai Qi attacked Chu, took Yan and Deng, and moved pardoned criminals there.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-eighth year, Grand Liangzao Bai Qi attacked Chu, captured Yan and Deng, and resettled pardoned criminals there.

sentences.zh: 二十九年，大良造白起攻楚，取郢為南郡，楚王走。

translations.literal: In the twenty-ninth year, Grand Liangzao Bai Qi attacked Chu, took Ying, and made it Nan Commandery. The King of Chu fled.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-ninth year, Grand Liangzao Bai Qi attacked Chu, captured Ying, and turned it into Nan Commandery. The King of Chu fled.

sentences.zh: 周君來。

translations.literal: The Lord of Zhou came.
translations.idiomatic: The Lord of Zhou came.

sentences.zh: 王與楚王會襄陵。

translations.literal: The king met with the King of Chu at Xiangling.
translations.idiomatic: The king met the King of Chu at Xiangling.

sentences.zh: 白起為武安君。

translations.literal: Bai Qi became Lord Wu'an.
translations.idiomatic: Bai Qi became Lord Wu'an.

sentences.zh: 三十年，蜀守若伐楚，取巫郡，及江南為黔中郡。

translations.literal: In the thirtieth year, Ruo, governor of Shu, attacked Chu, took Wu Commandery, and made the lands south of the Yangtze into Qianzhong Commandery.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirtieth year, Ruo, the governor of Shu, attacked Chu, captured Wu Commandery, and organized the lands south of the Yangtze as Qianzhong Commandery.

sentences.zh: 三十一年，白起伐魏，取兩城。

translations.literal: Thirty-first year, Bai Qi attacked Wei, took two cities.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-first year, Bai Qi attacked Wei and took two cities.

sentences.zh: 楚人反我江南。

translations.literal: The Chu people rebelled in our Jiangnan.
translations.idiomatic: The Chu people rebelled in our Jiangnan.

sentences.zh: 三十二年，相穰侯攻魏，至大梁，破暴鳶，斬首四萬，鳶走，魏入三縣請和。

translations.literal: In the thirty-second year, Chancellor Lord Rang attacked Wei and reached Daliang. He defeated Bao Yuan and beheaded forty thousand; Yuan fled, and Wei ceded three counties and requested peace.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-second year, Chancellor Lord Rang attacked Wei and reached Daliang. He defeated Bao Yuan and took forty thousand heads; Yuan fled, and Wei ceded three counties and asked for peace.

sentences.zh: 三十三年，客卿胡

translations.literal: Thirty-third year, guest minister Hu
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-third year, the guest minister Hu

translations.literal: (shang)
translations.idiomatic: (shang)

sentences.zh: ［陽］攻魏卷、蔡陽、長社，取之。

translations.literal: [Yang] attacked Wei Juan, Caiyang, Changshe, took them.
translations.idiomatic: Yang attacked Juan, Caiyang, and Changshe in Wei and captured them.

sentences.zh: 擊芒卯華陽，破之，斬首十五萬。

translations.literal: He attacked Mang Mao at Huayang, broke him, and beheaded one hundred fifty thousand.
translations.idiomatic: He attacked Mang Mao at Huayang, defeated him, and took one hundred fifty thousand heads.

sentences.zh: 魏入南陽以和。

translations.literal: Wei ceded Nanyang to make peace.
translations.idiomatic: Wei ceded Nanyang to make peace.

sentences.zh: 三十四年，秦與魏、韓上庸地為一郡，南陽免臣遷居之。

translations.literal: In the thirty-fourth year, Qin combined the Shangyong lands of Wei and Han into one commandery. Pardoned convicts from Nanyang were moved there to live.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-fourth year, Qin merged the Shangyong lands of Wei and Han into a single commandery, then moved pardoned convicts from Nanyang there to live.

sentences.zh: 三十五年，佐韓、魏、楚伐燕。

translations.literal: Thirty-fifth year, assisted Han, Wei, Chu attacked Yan.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-fifth year, he assisted Han, Wei, and Chu in attacking Yan.

sentences.zh: 初置南陽郡。

translations.literal: Nanyang Commandery was first established.
translations.idiomatic: Nanyang Commandery was first established.

sentences.zh: 三十六年，客卿灶攻齊，取剛、壽，予穰侯。

translations.literal: Thirty-sixth year, guest minister Zao attacked Qi, took Gang, Shou, gave Rang Hou.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-sixth year, Guest Minister Zao attacked Qi, took Gang and Shou, and gave them to Rang Hou.

sentences.zh: 三十八年，中更胡

translations.literal: Thirty-eighth year, zhonggeng Hu
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-eighth year, Zhonggeng Hu

translations.literal: (shang)
translations.idiomatic: (shang)

sentences.zh: ［陽］攻趙閼與，不能取。

translations.literal: [Yang] attacked Zhao Yuyu, could not take.
translations.idiomatic: Yang attacked Yuyu in Zhao but could not take it.

sentences.zh: 四十年，悼太子死魏，歸葬芷陽。

translations.literal: In the fortieth year, Crown Prince Dao died in Wei and was returned for burial in Zhiyang.
translations.idiomatic: In the fortieth year, Crown Prince Dao died in Wei, and his body was returned for burial at Zhiyang.

sentences.zh: 四十一年夏，攻魏，取邢丘、懷。

translations.literal: In summer of the forty-first year, they attacked Wei and took Xingqiu and Huai.
translations.idiomatic: In the summer of the forty-first year, Qin attacked Wei and captured Xingqiu and Huai.

sentences.zh: 四十二年，安國君為太子。

translations.literal: In the forty-second year, Lord Anguo became crown prince.
translations.idiomatic: In the forty-second year, Lord Anguo was made crown prince.

sentences.zh: 十月，宣太后薨，葬芷陽酈山。

translations.literal: In the tenth month, Empress Dowager Xuan died and was buried at Mount Li in Zhiyang.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, Empress Dowager Xuan died and received burial at Mount Li in Zhiyang.

sentences.zh: 九月，穰侯出之陶。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, Marquis Rang went to Tao.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, Marquis Rang departed for Tao.

sentences.zh: 四十三年，武安君白起攻韓，拔九城，斬首五萬。

translations.literal: In the forty-third year, Lord Wu’an Bai Qi attacked Han, captured nine cities, and beheaded fifty thousand.
translations.idiomatic: In the forty-third year, Lord Wu’an Bai Qi attacked Han, captured nine cities, and took fifty thousand heads.

sentences.zh: 四十四年，攻韓南

translations.literal: Forty-fourth year, attacked Han south
translations.idiomatic: In the forty-fourth year, Qin attacked Han's Nanyang

translations.literal: (jun)
translations.idiomatic: (jun)

sentences.zh: ［陽］，取之。

translations.literal: Yang, and captured it.
translations.idiomatic: Qin captured it.

sentences.zh: 四十五年，五大夫賁攻韓，取十城。

translations.literal: In the forty-fifth year, Fifth-rank Grandee Ben attacked Han and took ten cities.
translations.idiomatic: In the forty-fifth year, Fifth-rank Grandee Ben attacked Han and captured ten cities.

sentences.zh: 葉陽君悝出之國，未至而死。

translations.literal: Lord Yeyang Kui left for his state but died before arriving.
translations.idiomatic: Lord Yeyang Kui set out for his fief but died before he arrived.

sentences.zh: 四十七年，秦攻韓上黨，上黨降趙，秦因攻趙，趙發兵擊秦，相距。

translations.literal: In the forty-seventh year, Qin attacked Han's Shangdang. Shangdang surrendered to Zhao, so Qin attacked Zhao. Zhao sent troops to strike Qin, and the two armies faced each other.
translations.idiomatic: In the forty-seventh year, Qin attacked Han’s Shangdang. Shangdang surrendered to Zhao, so Qin attacked Zhao; Zhao sent troops against Qin, and the two armies faced each other.

sentences.zh: 秦使武安君白起擊，大破趙於長平，四十餘萬盡殺之。

translations.literal: Qin sent Lord Wu'an Bai Qi to attack. He crushed Zhao at Changping and killed more than four hundred thousand men.
translations.idiomatic: Qin sent Lord Wu’an Bai Qi to attack. He routed Zhao at Changping and killed more than four hundred thousand men.

sentences.zh: 四十八年十月，韓獻垣雍。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of the forty-eighth year, Han offered Yuanyong.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of the forty-eighth year, Han presented Yuanyong to Qin.

sentences.zh: 秦軍分為三軍。

translations.literal: Qin army divided into three armies.
translations.idiomatic: The Qin army was divided into three armies.

sentences.zh: 武安君歸。

translations.literal: Lord Wu'an returned.
translations.idiomatic: Lord Wu'an returned.

sentences.zh: 王龁將伐趙

translations.literal: Wang He led an attack on Zhao
translations.idiomatic: Wang He led an attack on Zhao

sentences.zh: （武安）

translations.literal: at Wu’an.
translations.idiomatic: at Wu’an.

sentences.zh: 皮牢，拔之。

translations.literal: Pilao, and captured them.
translations.idiomatic: He captured Pilao as well.

sentences.zh: 司馬梗北定太原，盡有韓上黨。

translations.literal: Sima Geng pacified Taiyuan in the north and took full possession of Han’s Shangdang.
translations.idiomatic: Sima Geng pacified Taiyuan in the north and fully occupied Han’s Shangdang.

sentences.zh: 正月，兵罷，復守上黨。

translations.literal: In the first month, the troops were dismissed, and they again guarded Shangdang.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month, the troops were dismissed, and Qin again garrisoned Shangdang.

sentences.zh: 其十月，五大夫陵攻趙邯鄲。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of that year, Fifth-rank Grandee Ling attacked Zhao’s Handan.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of that year, Fifth-rank Grandee Ling launched an attack on Zhao’s Handan.

sentences.zh: 四十九年正月，益發卒佐陵。

translations.literal: Forty-ninth year first month, increased dispatched troops assisted Ling.
translations.idiomatic: In the forty-ninth year, first month, they increased and dispatched troops to assist Ling.

sentences.zh: 陵戰不善，免，王龁代將。

translations.literal: Ling did not fight well and was dismissed; Wang He replaced him as commander.
translations.idiomatic: Ling fought poorly and was dismissed; Wang He replaced him in command.

sentences.zh: 其十月，將軍張唐攻魏，為蔡尉捐弗守，還斬之。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of that year, General Zhang Tang attacked Wei. Because Caiwei Juan failed to hold his post, Zhang Tang returned and beheaded him.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of that year, General Zhang Tang attacked Wei. When Caiwei Juan failed to hold his post, Zhang Tang returned and beheaded him.

sentences.zh: 五十年十月，武安君白起有罪，為士伍，遷陰密。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of the fiftieth year, Lord Wu’an Bai Qi was found guilty, reduced to common soldier status, and moved to Yinmi.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of the fiftieth year, Lord Wu’an Bai Qi was convicted, reduced to common soldier status, and moved to Yinmi.

sentences.zh: 張唐攻鄭，拔之。

translations.literal: Zhang Tang attacked Zheng and captured it.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Tang attacked Zheng and captured it.

sentences.zh: 十二月，益發卒軍汾城旁。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, they sent additional troops to camp beside Fencheng.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, Qin sent additional troops to camp beside Fencheng.

sentences.zh: 武安君白起有罪，死。

translations.literal: Lord Wu'an Bai Qi was found guilty and died.
translations.idiomatic: Lord Wu’an Bai Qi was convicted and died.

sentences.zh: 龁攻邯鄲，不拔，去，還奔汾軍。

translations.literal: Wang He attacked Handan but could not capture it. He withdrew and returned to the army at Fen.
translations.idiomatic: Wang He attacked Handan but could not take it. He withdrew and returned to the army at Fen.

sentences.zh: 二月餘攻晉軍，斬首六千，晉楚流死河二萬人。

translations.literal: For more than two months they attacked the Jin army, beheading six thousand; twenty thousand men of Jin and Chu drowned in the river.
translations.idiomatic: For more than two months they attacked the Jin army, taking six thousand heads; twenty thousand men of Jin and Chu drowned in the river.

sentences.zh: 攻汾城，即從唐拔寧新中，寧新中更名安陽。

translations.literal: They attacked Fencheng, then followed Tang in capturing Ningxinzhong. Ningxinzhong was renamed Anyang.
translations.idiomatic: They attacked Fencheng, then followed Tang in taking Ningxinzhong, which was renamed Anyang.

sentences.zh: 初作河橋。

translations.literal: They first built a bridge over the river.
translations.idiomatic: They were the first to build a bridge over the river.

sentences.zh: 五十一年，將軍摎攻韓，取陽城、負黍，斬首四萬。

translations.literal: In the fifty-first year, General Jiu attacked Han, took Yangcheng and Fushu, and beheaded forty thousand.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifty-first year, General Jiu attacked Han, captured Yangcheng and Fushu, and took forty thousand heads.

sentences.zh: 攻趙，取二十餘縣，首虜九萬。

translations.literal: They attacked Zhao, took more than twenty counties, and counted ninety thousand heads and captives.
translations.idiomatic: They attacked Zhao, captured more than twenty counties, and counted ninety thousand heads and prisoners.

sentences.zh: 西周君背秦，與諸侯約從，將天下銳兵出伊闕攻秦，令秦毋得通陽城。

translations.literal: The Lord of Western Zhou betrayed Qin and joined a vertical alliance with the feudal lords. He led the elite troops of all under heaven out through Yique to attack Qin, preventing Qin from reaching Yangcheng.
translations.idiomatic: The Lord of Western Zhou turned against Qin and made a vertical alliance with the feudal lords. He led the elite troops of all under heaven out through Yique to attack Qin and block its access to Yangcheng.

sentences.zh: 於是秦使將軍摎攻西周。

translations.literal: Qin then had General Jiu attack Western Zhou.
translations.idiomatic: Qin then sent General Jiu to attack Western Zhou.

sentences.zh: 西周君走來自歸，頓首受罪，盡獻其邑三十六城，口三萬。

translations.literal: The Lord of Western Zhou fled and came to surrender himself. He knocked his head to the ground, accepted his guilt, and offered up all thirty-six of his cities and thirty thousand people.
translations.idiomatic: The Lord of Western Zhou fled and came to surrender himself. He kowtowed, accepted his guilt, and offered up all thirty-six of his cities and thirty thousand people.

sentences.zh: 秦王受獻，歸其君於周。

translations.literal: The King of Qin accepted the offering and returned the lord to Zhou.
translations.idiomatic: The King of Qin accepted the offering and sent the lord back to Zhou.

sentences.zh: 五十二年，周民東亡，其器九鼎入秦。

translations.literal: In the fifty-second year, the Zhou people fled east, and their nine tripods entered Qin.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifty-second year, the people of Zhou fled east, and the nine tripods entered Qin.

sentences.zh: 周初亡。

translations.literal: This was the first extinction of Zhou.
translations.idiomatic: This was the first extinction of Zhou.

sentences.zh: 五十三年，天下來賓。

translations.literal: In the fifty-third year, all under Heaven came as guests.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifty-third year, all under Heaven came as guests at Qin.

sentences.zh: 魏後，秦使摎伐魏，取吳城。

translations.literal: After Wei delayed, Qin had Jiu attack Wei and take Wucheng.
translations.idiomatic: After Wei delayed, Qin sent Jiu to attack Wei and capture Wucheng.

sentences.zh: 韓王入朝，魏委國聽令。

translations.literal: The King of Han came to court, and Wei entrusted its state to Qin and obeyed Qin's commands.
translations.idiomatic: The King of Han came to court, and Wei entrusted its state to Qin and followed Qin’s commands.

sentences.zh: 五十四年，王郊見上帝於雍。

translations.literal: In the fifty-fourth year, the king performed suburban rites to the Supreme Deity at Yong.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifty-fourth year, the king performed the suburban sacrifice to the Supreme Deity at Yong.
